# FLX-3713: a consumer query reads a projection alias of its own SELECT

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A column that a SELECT writes in a later projection, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING or QUALIFY, or inside an expression of its ORDER BY, is the alias of one of its own projections. Reading an alias there makes the checker write the alias's expression in its place, and a chain of aliases that read each other doubles the text at every step, so the text is refused before it is expanded. Write the expression out. An ORDER BY key that is just an output column's name (ORDER BY n DESC) is accepted.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3713
```
